title: Lore
tagline: Lore a project onboarding interactive experience built on Polygon, Livepeer, Moralis, NFTPort and Covalent!
description: Lore a project onboarding interactive experience built on Polygon, Livepeer, Moralis, NFTPort and Covalent! We are building a platform that helps Innovators, Developers and Creators engage and educate their audiences via live interactive video, trivia, play alongs and other experiences.
how_its_made:
The project is built using 



1. Front End - NextJS, MDBootstrap, Recoil, Moralis (wallet connection, get native balance, get NFTs, authentication), NFTPort (Dynamic Minting, Contract Deployment, Find Counterfeit NFTs), Covalent (Get Token Balances, Get external metadata)



2. Back End - Php, Postgresql, Moralis API, Covalent API, NFT Port API
